name: Hamura (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Hamura city emblem in white: a disc bearing a maroon stylised swirl of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Hamura, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1956.

features.role: Hamura city emblem — a disc bearing a maroon stylised swirl of curved strokes
